_note: How the heroes move their weapons (src/hero/hero_look.gd). Presentation only: the hit itself happens when the attack is made; these values only shape how the blade looks before, during and after it.

sword._guard_note: guard: the swordsman's resting hold (user 2026-11-01: like a swordsman, not a pointer at head height). hand = where the hand sits from the shoulder in hero art px, x toward the facing side, y down (about hip height in front of the body). tilt = radians the blade leans forward from upright. aim_lean = at most this many radians the blade follows the aim up or down. off_hand / off_tilt: the second blade in Rage, held on the other side and crossed further forward.
sword._swing_note: swing: one sword stroke, as shares of time (seconds). The blade always cuts from the end of the arc nearest its guard (a downward cut from the raised blade); Rage's mirrored second swing cuts back the other way. lift = share spent raising the blade from the guard to the start of the arc (the anticipation, kept short so the stroke follows the click at once). strike = share at which the cut has crossed the arc and overshoot radians past it (fast, eased out by strike_ease, Godot ease() curve: below 1 eases out). settle = share at which the follow-through ends and the blade starts back to the guard (eased in and out). reach = weapon art px from the shoulder to the hand while cutting. lean = hero art px the body leans into the cut.
